answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by forcing every new key through a narrow inlet that records a live decision pulse under load before granting standing. Later epochs fire echo probes that re-ask timing-sensitive choices from that first pulse window. Cloned farm keys share the same pulse fingerprint and collide on the echo, so the bonded set is slashed together. An attacker must fund N independent minds through the inlet, not mint N empty wallets.
